items.title: Cartier–Gabriel–Kostant decomposition of cocommutative Hopf algebras in characteristic zero
items.difficulty_reason: Decompose the pointed cocommutative coalgebra by grouplike blocks and isolate the identity Hopf component. On its associated coradical graded, pass from lower-degree surjectivity to a symmetric reduced coproduct satisfying (5.18). Lemma5.10.3 uses an abelian polynomial extension and the doubling identity to construct w=(2^d−2)^{-1}u(x,x) for each relevant homogeneous degree. Subtract w to leave a primitive, which lies in the symmetric-algebra image; this closes surjectivity and the semidirect reconstruction. Count the entire cocycle proof and its use within this one H2.
